-- Lookups, built once.
local byId = {}
local byRarity = {}
for _, def in ipairs(BrainrotCatalog.BRAINROTS) do
	byId[def.id] = def
	byRarity[def.rarity] = byRarity[def.rarity] or {}
	table.insert(byRarity[def.rarity], def)
end
BrainrotCatalog.byId = byId
BrainrotCatalog.byRarity = byRarity

function BrainrotCatalog.getById(id)
	return byId[id]
end

function BrainrotCatalog.rarityColor(rarityName)
	for _, r in ipairs(BrainrotCatalog.RARITIES) do
		if r.name == rarityName then
			return r.color
		end
	end
	return Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
end

function BrainrotCatalog.rarityIndex(rarityName)
	for i, r in ipairs(BrainrotCatalog.RARITIES) do
		if r.name == rarityName then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 1
end

function BrainrotCatalog.nextRarity(rarityName)
	local idx = BrainrotCatalog.rarityIndex(rarityName)
	return BrainrotCatalog.RARITIES[math.min(idx + 1, #BrainrotCatalog.RARITIES)].name
end

-- Weighted roll over a {name, weight} style table. Returns the picked entry.
local function rollWeighted(list)
	local total = 0
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		total = total + entry.weight
	end
	local roll = math.random() * total
	for _, entry in ipairs(list) do
		roll = roll - entry.weight
		if roll <= 0 then
			return entry
		end
	end
	return list[1]
end

function BrainrotCatalog.rollRarity()
	return rollWeighted(BrainrotCatalog.RARITIES).name
end

function BrainrotCatalog.rollMutation()
	if math.random() > BrainrotCatalog.MUTATION_CHANCE then
		return nil
	end
	return rollWeighted(BrainrotCatalog.MUTATIONS)
end

-- Rolls one brainrot definition: rarity first, then a random member of it.
function BrainrotCatalog.rollBrainrot()
	local rarity = BrainrotCatalog.rollRarity()
	local pool = byRarity[rarity]
	return pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
end

-- Final income of a brainrot instance: base x mutation x rebirth bonus.
function BrainrotCatalog.incomeFor(def, mutation, rebirthTier)
	local mult = 1
	if mutation then
		mult = mult * mutation.mult
	end
	mult = mult * (1 + 0.25 * (rebirthTier or 0))
	return math.floor(def.income * mult)
end

return BrainrotCatalog

	local startCFrame = model:GetPivot()
	local steps = 20

		local alpha = step / steps
		local pos = startCFrame.Position:Lerp(targetCFrame.Position, alpha)
		local cf = CFrame.new(pos) * targetCFrame.Rotation
		model:PivotTo(cf)
		task.wait(duration / steps)
	end
	model:PivotTo(targetCFrame)

	if not character then
		BaseService.returnStolen(victim, inst)
		return
	end
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or not root then
		BaseService.returnStolen(victim, inst)
		return
	end
	local thiefState = DataService.getState(thief)
	local thiefBase = BaseService.baseOf(thief)
	local carried = true
	local diedConn
	diedConn = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		carried = false
	end)
	while carried do
		task.wait(0.1)
		if not thief.Parent or not thiefState then
			carried = false
			break
		end
		local char = thief.Character
		local rt = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not rt then
			carried = false
			break
		end
		local pos = rt.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
		if inst.model and inst.model.Parent then
			inst.model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
		end
		-- Reached home? The thief's base center is the home zone.
		if thiefBase and (rt.Position - thiefBase.center).Magnitude < 14 then
			local slotIndex = DataService.freeSlotIndex(thief)
			if slotIndex then
				inst.owner = thief
				BaseService.placeOnSlot(thief, inst, slotIndex)
				local QuestService = require(script.Parent.QuestService)
				QuestService.report(thief, "steal", 1)
				carried = false
			end
		end
	end
	if diedConn then
		diedConn:Disconnect()
	end
	if carried == false and inst.where == "carried" then
		BaseService.returnStolen(victim, inst)
	end
end

function BaseService.returnStolen(victim, inst)
	local victimState = DataService.getState(victim)
	if not victimState then
		if inst.model and inst.model.Parent then
			inst.model:Destroy()
		end
		return
	end
	local slotIndex = DataService.freeSlotIndex(victim)
	if slotIndex then
		BaseService.placeOnSlot(victim, inst, slotIndex)
	else
		if inst.model and inst.model.Parent then

		end
	end
end

function BrainrotSpawner.spawnBrainrot(forcedMutation)

	local mutation = forcedMutation or Catalog.rollMutation()
	local uid = DataService.newUid()
	local model = WorldBuilder.buildBrainrotModel(def, mutation)
	model:SetAttribute("uid", uid)
	WorldBuilder.setIncomeLabel(model, "$" .. Catalog.incomeFor(def, mutation, 0) .. "/s")

	local startPos = world.conveyor.startPos
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(startPos, startPos + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)))
	model.Parent = beltFolder

	local inst = {
		uid = uid,
		defId = def.id,
		mutation = mutation,
		owner = nil,
		where = "conveyor",
		model = model,

	}

local function stepBelt(dt)
	local startX = world.conveyor.startPos.X
	local endX = world.conveyor.endPos.X
	local i = 1
	while i <= #DataService.Conveyor do
		local inst = DataService.Conveyor[i]
		inst.x = inst.x + GameConfig.CONVEYOR_SPEED * dt
		if inst.x >= endX then
			BrainrotSpawner.removeFromConveyor(inst)
		else
			local pos = Vector3.new(inst.x, world.conveyor.startPos.Y, world.conveyor.startPos.Z)
			if inst.model and inst.model.Parent then
				inst.model:PivotTo(CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)))
			end
			i = i + 1
		end
	end
end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(GameConfig.CONVEYOR_INTERVAL)
			if #DataService.Conveyor < GameConfig.CONVEYOR_MAX then
				BrainrotSpawner.spawnBrainrot()
			end
		end
	end)
	task.spawn(function()
		local last = os.clock()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.1)
			local now = os.clock()
			stepBelt(now - last)
			last = now
		end
	end)
end

return BrainrotSpawner

-- Feed it 3 brainrots of the same rarity from your base and it spits out
-- 1 brainrot of the next rarity up. The three go in; one better comes out.

-- Fuses 3 of the player's own slot brainrots (same rarity) into one of
-- the next rarity. Returns true + the new brainrot's name on success.
function FuseService.fuse(player, uid1, uid2, uid3)
	local state = DataService.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return false, "No state"
	end
	local uids = { uid1, uid2, uid3 }
	local picked = {}
	for _, uid in ipairs(uids) do
		local found = nil
		for slotIndex, inst in ipairs(state.slots) do
			if inst and inst.uid == uid then
				found = { inst = inst, slot = slotIndex }
				break
			end
		end
		if not found then
			return false, "One of those brainrots is not on your base"
		end
		table.insert(picked, found)
	end
	local rarity = Catalog.getById(picked[1].inst.defId).rarity
	for _, entry in ipairs(picked) do
		if Catalog.getById(entry.inst.defId).rarity ~= rarity then
			return false, "All three must share a rarity!"
		end
	end
	if rarity == "Prismatic" then
		return false, "Prismatic cannot be fused further!"
	end
	-- Remove the three.
	for _, entry in ipairs(picked) do
		state.slots[entry.slot] = nil
		if entry.inst.model and entry.inst.model.Parent then
			entry.inst.model:Destroy()
		end
	end
	-- Roll one of the next rarity up.
	local nextRarity = Catalog.nextRarity(rarity)
	local pool = Catalog.byRarity[nextRarity]
	local def = pool[math.random(1, #pool)]
	local mutation = Catalog.rollMutation()
	local slotIndex = DataService.freeSlotIndex(player)
	if not slotIndex then
		return false, "No free slot for the result"
	end
	local uid = DataService.newUid()
	local model = WorldBuilder.buildBrainrotModel(def, mutation)
	model:SetAttribute("uid", uid)
	WorldBuilder.setIncomeLabel(model, "$" .. Catalog.incomeFor(def, mutation, state.rebirthTier) .. "/s")
	-- The fused brainrot pops out of the Fuse-O-Matic, then walks home.
	model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(Vector3.new(18, 4, 34)))
	model.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace").BodegaWorld
	local inst = {
		uid = uid,
		defId = def.id,
		mutation = mutation,
		owner = player,
		where = "base",
		model = model,
	}
	local InteractionService = require(script.Parent.InteractionService)
	InteractionService.attach(model, inst)
	BaseService.placeOnSlot(player, inst, slotIndex)
	DataService.markDiscovered(player, def.id)
	return true, "FUSED into " .. def.name .. " (" .. nextRarity .. ")!"

function QuestService.report(player, kind, amount)
	local state = DataService.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return
	end
	for _, quest in ipairs(QuestService.QUESTS) do
		if quest.kind == kind then
			local current = state.quests[quest.id] or 0
			if current < quest.target then
				state.quests[quest.id] = math.min(quest.target, current + amount)
			end
		end
	end

function QuestService.claimQuest(player, questId)
	local state = DataService.getState(player)
	if not state then
		return false, "No state"
	end
	local quest = nil
	for _, q in ipairs(QuestService.QUESTS) do
		if q.id == questId then
			quest = q
			break
		end
	end
	if not quest then
		return false, "Unknown quest"
	end
	if state.questsClaimed[questId] then
		return false, "Already claimed"
	end
	local progress = state.quests[questId] or 0
	if progress < quest.target then
		return false, "Not complete yet"
	end
	state.questsClaimed[questId] = true
	DataService.addCash(player, quest.reward)
	return true, "Quest complete! +$" .. quest.reward
end

function QuestService.snapshot(player)
	local state = DataService.getState(player)
	local out = {}
	for _, quest in ipairs(QuestService.QUESTS) do
		local progress = state and (state.quests[quest.id] or 0) or 0
		table.insert(out, {
			id = quest.id,
			name = quest.name,
			desc = quest.desc,
			progress = progress,
			target = quest.target,
			reward = quest.reward,
			claimed = state and state.questsClaimed[quest.id] or false,
		})
	end
	return out
